measurements.after_structural_shell: Reopened asset base matches all 30 distinct transformed source-ring points with 0.0 m maximum residual.
measurements.position_status: Base footprint exactly follows the transformed 30-point official campus map polygon; the source publishes no positional accuracy.
measurements.plan_dimension_status: Footprint follows the official polygon. FHC's 23,288 sq ft listing has no stated area convention; Meyer Najem's 5,000 sq ft refers to a renovation scope, not total building area.
measurements.orientation_status: Wall orientation follows the source-ring edges. A west-facing long edge was selected for the portico from address and illustrative context only; the entry side has not been georeferenced.
measurements.height_status: Estimated 7.6 m eaves and 10.0 m ridge; no measured elevation found. GIS NUM_LEVELS=1 conflicts with contractor description of two stories; source field convention is undocumented.

geometry_edits: Replaced the simple massing with a two-level mesh whose base preserves all 30 official source-ring vertices.
Added repeated window bays, floor band, plinth, light trim, and a low roof membrane across the full mapped outline.
Added a compact estimated gable roof, a columned entrance porch, red entry doors, and front steps using the exact-address house illustration for broad visual vocabulary.
Removed unused placeholder texture materials so the saved building library has no external image dependencies.
Preserved the assigned asset ID, path, object name, one-object collection, campus coordinate frame, and identity object transform.
uncertainties: Purdue campus GIS is not a certified survey and publishes no positional or dimensional uncertainty.
GIS NUM_LEVELS=1 conflicts with the contractor's two-story description and the stylized operator-address illustration; the GIS field definition is unknown.
Eaves, ridge, central gable size, facade rhythm, entry position/orientation, and material colors are estimates; no measured elevation or georeferenced facade photograph was located.
The FHC published square footage and the GIS area use unspecified or different area conventions and should not be treated as directly equivalent.

independent_grade.summary: Exact GIS footprint match and modular export pass; GIS floor-count conflict, unmeasured heights/roof, facade details, and entry bearing remain uncertain.
